counting_functions: build_source_audit.normalize_text, word_count and sentence_count; sentence count is heuristic
canonical_evidence_rule: lexicographically first (Wikipedia page, sentence ID) among complete single-sentence evidence sets
capacity_note: Metadata capacity only; neither semantic deduplication nor a count of verified distinct facts.
preview_selection: ascending sha256(seed|claim_id), one canonical page per preview record
source_preview_findings: Entity disambiguation and nonexclusive relation scope need review
evidence_snapshot: June 2017 Wikipedia dump referenced by the original dataset
limitations: SUPPORTS is a source-selection annotation, not a confidence-probe label or a guarantee of current truth.
Evidence locators do not substitute for checking evidence text.
A filtered capacity above 5000 does not establish 5000 acceptable facts; pilot review yield and topic coverage remain unknown.
Variants and overlapping fact/source groups must stay in the same downstream split.
